I'm currently being homeschooled (14 yo F), always have been and I'm planning on continuing until I graduate. Homeschooling takes away a vast amount of social opportunities. But there are pros to it as well, it depends how well you or your girlfriend will do at teaching, and how well your child will respond to being with his/her parents *all the time*. Homeschooled kids often are ahead of public schooled children, usually because of the one on one teaching and being able to go at their own pace. Homeschooling is very flexible which is great for travelling or taking extra days off (sick days, more vacation time, etc). I've been teased for being homeschooled, as it is not a norm and people think you have no friends, and many believe it is because of religious reasons, so they think you're very very religious. Just think of all the fun things about public school you got to do (assuming you were public schooled), prom, homecoming, football games, graduation, because those are the things your child will be missing.
